entities.summary: Beat Zehnder is a Swiss Formula One engineer. Since 2025, Zehnder has served as Director of Signature Programs and Operations at Sauber; having previously served as Sporting Director. Zehnder has been with the Swiss team since its inception in 1993, and had attended every single race until the 2025 Monaco Grand Prix
